# Thermal Products Inc.

> > Thermal Products Inc. is a wholesale distributor of hydronic heating systems, boilers, radiant heating, and HVAC components serving the West Coast and Alaska from Edmonds, WA.

Founded in Seattle/North Seattle and now based in Edmonds, WA, Thermal Products Inc. specializes in premium hydronic heating solutions including brands like Viessmann, NTI, Navien, Viega, Grundfos, TACO, and Caleffi. The company serves contractors and mechanical professionals across the West Coast, Alaska, and Colorado with expertise in radiant heating systems, boilers, and low-temperature heating applications.

## Key Topics

- Hydronic heating systems
- Radiant heating and underfloor systems
- Boilers and tankless water heaters
- Heat pumps and low-temperature heating
- Viessmann, NTI, Navien brands
- Viega Climate Panel
- Roth Panel and Climate Trak
- Grundfos and TACO pumps
- Caleffi valves and components
- Wholesale HVAC distribution
- Retrofit heating systems
- West Coast and Alaska service area
- Seattle/Edmonds, WA location
- Buffer tanks and thermal storage
